title: Four Jacksonville Dolphins men's basketball players receive NABC academic honors - Duval Times
text:
Four Jacksonville Dolphins men's basketball players receive NABC academic honors
A. N. Kent
Four former Jacksonville Dolphins men's basketball players received National Association of Basketball Coaches (NABC) Academic Honors Court recognition, the NABC announced on July 15. Allen Udemadu, Jaylen Jordon, Simon Wheeler, and Tito Deng all achieved above a 3.2 GPA as upperclassmen during the 2025-26 basketball season.
Seniors Udemadu, Jordon, and Wheeler, along with junior Deng, contributed to Jacksonville posting a program record 3.35 GPA for the season. Udemadu was also named to the All-ASUN Academic Team and maintained a 3.835 GPA in his Master of Organizational Leadership track.
The NABC annually recognizes teams and student-athletes nationwide for their academic success. This year, over 2,300 student-athletes were honored on the NABC Honors Court.
This marks the second consecutive year that at least one Jacksonville player has been named to the NABC Honors Court and is the fifth time in program history. The 2025-26 season featured more Dolphins receiving this honor than any previous year.
Additionally on Wednesday, Jacksonville men's basketball announced that its season ticket packages are now available.
